what_was_extended: The approved ABI_CONTRACT_EXPORT_CALLBACK witness could only see a callback operand that was a linear entry parameter. It now follows the operand back through register-to-register copies, frame spill/reload pairs, and loop phis whose every incoming value satisfies the same rule. Call results, immediates, arithmetic, rip-relative loads and overwritten spill slots break the chain and refuse.

refused.why: the callback parameter is forwarded to the private worker with push, and _arg_origin_at_call does not model push, so it reports a false parameter index; the header check catches the false index and the site refuses. The in-image PEM_def_callback fallback WAS correctly enumerated (named in .dynsym) but the parameter arm is not reachable to the witness.
the value reaching the call is push $0x0 (a NULL constant) through a stack argument, not an exported entry parameter.
the value is lea of an in-image keygen function through a stack argument, not an exported entry parameter.

why_three_were_not_forced: Reaching 16 would have required accepting a push-forwarded argument with no matching exported parameter (a false positive) or accepting a computed constant as if it were a parameter. Both are widenings; the worker refused instead.

controls.collateral: 13 out-of-group sites also moved materialised -> ABI_CONTRACT_EXPORT_CALLBACK (cts128 x3, nistcts x3, ASN1_d2i_bio, ASN1_d2i_fp, LH_doall_arg_thunk, ASN1_dup x3, ASN1_sign). All are unreachable and therefore outside the element-7 population; they are recorded here rather than presented as precision.
controls.mutation: removing the chain fallback drops accepted sites 13 -> 8; the five reverted are exactly cbc, ofb, LH_doall and the two ccm sites (pk8/p12 were already refused). Tool restored byte-identically at 5b3705a4...

discovered_obligation.why: _arg_origin_at_call does not model push, so a stack-argument forwarding can be reported as a parameter index that does not exist. Here the header check caught it; the model should still be fixed, and until it is, any site that forwards an argument with push must be treated as unattributable.

non_claims: Element 7 is still FAIL; 47 target-bounded sites remain and the 3 refused sites are not counted as progress.
The 13 out-of-group moves are unreachable sites and are not claimed as element-7 precision.

review.verdict_text: REJECT -- the chain rule itself is largely sound, but the batch bundles an undisclosed second admission change that its own mutation control proves is doing 8 of the 13 closures.
blocking_findings: _strip_preprocessor rewrites the header gate; it is undisclosed in what_was_extended, has no fixture, and the mutation (13->8) concedes that only five sites depend on the chain; the other eight depend on it.
the in-image fallback arm is joined with `or` and drops the null-test conjunct that its own docstrings state as mandatory.
the class moved 47->58 (+11) and unresolved 131->129 (-2) while 13 closures are claimed: two of the claimed thirteen never entered the class and are unaccounted for.
six provider::cipher::cts128_* functions are REACHABLE and match the "cts128 x3" collateral label, so three classification moves are not shown to be unreachable.
no mixed-arm phi negative control exists; the phi soundness is code-reading only.

outcome.action: the tool was reverted to the last approved sha (0952c5dd4 content)
outcome.counted: 0 of 16; the three refusals were correct but do not offset the widening
outcome.evidence_files: closure-ssh-b53-e7cb.json and inventory-sshd-b53-e7cb.json were produced by the rejected tool and are retained only as negative evidence; the authoritative closures remain the e7slh-r3 pair

residuals.why: _arg_origin_at_call does not model push; a push-forwarded argument can be reported as a non-existent parameter index. Until fixed, push-forwarded arguments must be treated as unattributable.
cross-block lea escaping a "no-store" slot, and the _prologue_delta fallback, can still yield a false stack-argument index.
a chain-only change (copies, spills, phis) must be re-landed separately, without the header-gate rewrite, with a mixed-arm phi control and an exact accounting of which sites depend on which step.
